Are you ready for a new challenge in logistics? At AS Watson in Oosterhout, we are looking for motivated new colleagues. Are you looking for a varied job where you can stay active, work in a friendly team, and have opportunities to grow? Then this position as an OrderPicker could be perfect for you!

Together with your colleagues, you make sure that all orders are picked carefully, processed on time, and prepared for shipment. You will use a voicepicking system, available in Dutch, English, and Polish, that guides you through the warehouse step by step.

You will pick a wide variety of products, from soft drinks and shampoo to toys and cleaning products. With your pallet-building skills, you make sure that every pallet is stacked carefull and correctly, so the stores receive everything they need. The orders are never the same, which means every working day is different!

- You are motivated and a hard worker.
- You are available to work in a 2-shift schedule: 06:00–14:00 and 14:00–22:00.
- You enjoy working as part of a team.
- You work accurately and have an eye for quality.
- You are available to work at least 2 Saturdays per month.
- You have your own transportation, such as a car or bicycle.
- You have a good command of English, to understand work instructions and communicate with your colleagues.

Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

Welcome to Regional Jet Center 
Our daily operation is supported by several specialized workshops, including the Sheet Metal Workshop . Here, we repair and restore aluminium components. When there's less repair work, you'll also be deployed on the hangar floor and work directly on the aircraft. 
What will you do? 
As a Sheet Metal Worker, you'll mainly start in the workshop, but you'll also regularly work on the aircraft in the hangar. You will work day, evening, night, and weekend shifts. Your tasks include: - 
Manufacturing, repairing, and modifying aircraft sheet metal on the apron, in the hangar, and in the workshop; - 
Assessing damage in accordance with regulations and determining the appropriate repair methods; - 
Carrying out repairs and modifications, both on-aircraft and in the workshop; - 
Reading and interpreting drawings and technical specifications; - 
Measuring and marking sheet metal according to drawings and templates; - 
Cutting, bending, punching, drilling, and straightening sheet metal using metalworking machines (incl. presses, punch machines, and CNC equipment); - 
Grinding and polishing seams, joints, and rough surfaces; - 
Forming various alloys according to drawing specifications; - 
Checking the quality of products and installations to ensure compliance; - 
Certifying the airworthiness of repaired aircraft components; - 
Maintaining a clean and safe working environment. Job requirements 
 - 
At least 3 years of relevant sheet-metal experience; - 
Knowledge of EASA laws and regulations; - 
Good command of both Dutch and English; - 
Holder of a Category B driving licence; - 
Must be an EU resident/citizen. 
Note: You don't need to possess every single skill or experience listed. We're not looking for a "perfect" candidate-just talented and resourceful professionals.
